SELECT account_row.id FROM user_account account_row WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_identity identity_row WHERE identity_row.user_id = account_row.id AND identity_row.identity_type = 'EMAIL' AND identity_row.issuer = 'local' AND identity_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND strpos(lower(identity_row.normalized_identifier), #{account.email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 )
AND strpos(lower(account_row.display_name), #{account.displayName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
mapper.select:
WITH account_activity AS ( SELECT actor_user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS access_count, BOOL_OR(event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS visited, BOOL_OR() AS used FROM audit_event WHERE actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR actor_user_id = #{account.userId})
AND actor_user_id IN ()
GROUP BY actor_user_id ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(access_count), 0) AS access_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visited) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(*) AS active_users, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE used) AS actual_users FROM account_activity

WITH local_events AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT e.actor_user_id, (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS activity_day, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text)))::integer AS activity_hour, e.event_type = 'APP_VISIT' AS visited, () AS used, e.event_type = 'LOGIN' AS logged_in, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'LOGIN' THEN COALESCE(e.details->>'deviceType', 'UNKNOWN') END AS device_type FROM audit_event e WHERE e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{account.userId})
AND e.actor_user_id IN ()
), account_days AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT activity_day, actor_user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visited) AS access_count, BOOL_OR(visited) AS visited, BOOL_OR(used) AS used FROM local_events GROUP BY activity_day, actor_user_id ), account_activity AS (
SELECT actor_user_id, SUM(access_count) AS access_count, BOOL_OR(visited) AS visited, BOOL_OR(used) AS used FROM account_days GROUP BY actor_user_id ), daily_activity AS ( SELECT activity_day, SUM(access_count) AS access_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visited) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(*) AS active_users, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE used) AS actual_users FROM account_days GROUP BY activity_day ), days AS (
SELECT generated.day::date AS activity_day FROM generate_series(CAST(#{period.fromDate} AS timestamp without time zone), CAST(#{period.toDateExclusive} AS timestamp without time zone) - interval '1 day', interval '1 day') AS generated(day) ), new_accounts AS (
SELECT activity_day, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts FROM ( SELECT (u.created_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS activity_day FROM user_account u WHERE u.created_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND u.created_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR u.id = #{account.userId})
AND u.id IN ()
) local_account GROUP BY activity_day ), hours AS (SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS hour), hourly_activity AS (
SELECT activity_hour AS hour, COUNT(*) AS operation_count FROM local_events WHERE used GROUP BY activity_hour ), account_devices AS (
SELECT device_type, actor_user_id, COUNT(*) AS login_count FROM local_events WHERE logged_in GROUP BY device_type, actor_user_id ), devices AS ( SELECT device_type, SUM(login_count) AS login_count, COUNT(*) AS unique_users FROM account_devices GROUP BY device_type )
SELECT 'SUMMARY' AS metric_kind, NULL::text AS bucket, COALESCE(SUM(access_count), 0) AS access_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visited) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(*) AS active_users, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE used) AS actual_users, 0 AS new_accounts, 0 AS operation_count, 0 AS login_count, 0 AS unique_users FROM account_activity UNION ALL SELECT 'DAILY', to_char(days.activity_day, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), COALESCE(daily_activity.access_count, 0), COALESCE(daily_activity.unique_visitors, 0), COALESCE(daily_activity.active_users, 0), COALESCE(daily_activity.actual_users, 0), COALESCE(new_accounts.new_accounts, 0), 0, 0, 0 FROM days LEFT JOIN daily_activity USING (activity_day) LEFT JOIN new_accounts USING (activity_day) UNION ALL SELECT 'HOURLY', hours.hour::text, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, COALESCE(hourly_activity.operation_count, 0), 0, 0 FROM hours LEFT JOIN hourly_activity USING (hour) UNION ALL SELECT 'DEVICE', device_type, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, login_count, unique_users FROM devices
ORDER BY metric_kind, login_count DESC, bucket

WITH days AS ( SELECT generated.day::date AS activity_day FROM generate_series( CAST(#{period.fromDate} AS timestamp without time zone), CAST(#{period.toDateExclusive} AS timestamp without time zone) - interval '1 day', interval '1 day' ) AS generated(day) ), account_days AS (
SELECT activity_day, actor_user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS access_count, BOOL_OR(event_type = 'APP_VISIT') AS visited, BOOL_OR() AS used FROM ( SELECT (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS activity_day, e.event_type, e.actor_user_id FROM audit_event e WHERE e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{account.userId})
AND e.actor_user_id IN ()
) local_event GROUP BY activity_day, actor_user_id ), activity AS (
SELECT activity_day, SUM(access_count) AS access_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visited) AS unique_visitors, COUNT(*) AS active_users, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE used) AS actual_users FROM account_days GROUP BY activity_day ), accounts AS ( SELECT activity_day, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts FROM ( SELECT (u.created_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text))::date AS activity_day FROM user_account u WHERE u.created_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND u.created_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR u.id = #{account.userId})
AND u.id IN ()
) local_account GROUP BY activity_day ) SELECT days.activity_day, COALESCE(activity.access_count, 0) AS access_count, COALESCE(activity.unique_visitors, 0) AS unique_visitors, COALESCE(activity.active_users, 0) AS active_users, COALESCE(activity.actual_users, 0) AS actual_users, COALESCE(accounts.new_accounts, 0) AS new_accounts FROM days LEFT JOIN activity USING (activity_day) LEFT JOIN accounts USING (activity_day) ORDER BY days.activity_day

WITH hours AS (SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS hour), activity AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE CAST(#{period.zoneIdText} AS text)))::integer AS hour, COUNT(*) AS operation_count FROM audit_event e WHERE e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type IN ('OPTIMIZATION_SUBMITTED', 'PLAN_CREATED', 'CONTEXT_PREPARED', 'CONTEXT_ANALYZED', 'RESULT_EXPORTED', 'RECHARGE_PAID') AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{account.userId})
AND e.actor_user_id IN ()
GROUP BY hour ) SELECT hours.hour, COALESCE(activity.operation_count, 0) AS operation_count FROM hours LEFT JOIN activity USING (hour) ORDER BY hours.hour

WITH account_devices AS ( SELECT COALESCE(e.details->>'deviceType', 'UNKNOWN') AS device_type, e.actor_user_id, COUNT(*) AS login_count FROM audit_event e WHERE e.event_type = 'LOGIN' AND e.actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.occurred_at >= #{period.fromInclusive} AND e.occurred_at < #{period.toExclusive} AND (CAST(#{account.userId} AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.actor_user_id = #{account.userId})
AND e.actor_user_id IN ()
GROUP BY device_type, e.actor_user_id ) SELECT device_type, SUM(login_count) AS login_count, COUNT(*) AS unique_users FROM account_devices GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY login_count DESC, device_type

SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.actor_user_id AS user_id, COALESCE((SELECT u.display_name FROM user_account u WHERE u.id = e.actor_user_id), '') AS display_name, e.event_type, e.occurred_at, e.details->>'clientIp' AS client_ip, e.details->>'country' AS country, e.details->>'province' AS province, e.details->>'city' AS city, e.details->>'loginCountry' AS login_country, e.details->>'loginProvince' AS login_province, e.details->>'loginCity' AS login_city, COALESCE(e.details->>'deviceType', 'UNKNOWN') AS device_type FROM audit_event e
ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id
